All scheduled talks and plenary sessions will be held in lecture hall **T.B.D.**.
Four adjacent seminar rooms (T.B.D. – T.B.D.) will host the breakout sessions. The **foyer of
Building W** will serve as the catering area for lunch and coffee breaks.

See [Venue](venue.qmd) for maps and directions.

The agenda below is **preliminary** and may still change.

## Session types

The programme combines invited keynotes, contributed presentations, and collaborative breakout
sessions:

* <span class="slotcat plenary">**Keynotes**</span> have a 45-minute slot and set the stage for the
  discussion of the day.
* <span class="slotcat contributed">**Presentations**</span> are contributed talks of roughly 20
  minutes each.
* <span class="slotcat handson">**Breakout sessions**</span> are the core of the workshop. In parallel
  sessions, small groups work on the [four research directions](index.qmd), with the goal
  of critically assessing progress since the original priority research directions and identifying
  open challenges.
* <span class="slotcat oneidea">**Presentation of breakout findings**</span> brings the groups back
  together to report their results to all participants.
* <span class="slotcat open">**Organisational and collaborative slots**</span> — session overview,
  session alignment, status sync, final result preparation, and the social event — are used to
  coordinate between the groups and to prepare the joint outcome of the workshop.

The findings collected during the breakout sessions form the basis of the [joint scientific article](publication.qmd)
that will be prepared after the workshop.
